requirement_text.REQ-005: Add 'kk' to src/i18n/routing.ts's locales array (now ["ru","uz","en","kk"]), defaultLocale stays "ru". Create messages/kk.json matching messages/ru.json's 177-leaf-key structure, every value duplicated verbatim from ru.json as a placeholder including Metadata.ogLocale="ru_RU". Acceptance criteria: locales array correct; messages/kk.json key-set matches ru.json exactly with non-empty values; visiting /kk renders <html lang="kk"> with /ru, /uz, /en unregressed; LocaleSwitcher renders four working options (RU/UZ/EN/KK) navigating correctly between all four locale prefixes with anchors preserved; npm run build has no type/routing errors; /kk renders all landing sections with no missing-translation-key errors.

task.description: This requirement has a real user-visible surface (a new /kk route and a fourth LocaleSwitcher option), so run the full Step 3 procedure. Use docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-003.md as your direct template (the analogous prior spec for adding a locale) — same shape of checks, updated for a fourth locale instead of a third. Write docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-005.md: a concrete, mechanically-runnable manual verification case for each REQ-005 acceptance criterion — exact route, exact viewport(s)/theme(s), exact expected result. Actually run every script/curl command against the real current files/server during authoring — no speculative 'expected' output (this project's own history has a real defect from REQ-004's test spec where expected values were fabricated rather than actually run — do not repeat that).
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-005 acceptance criterion has at least one verification case
Each case names the exact route, viewport(s), theme(s), and expected result — not 'check it looks right'

result.summary: Wrote docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-005.md: 7 verification cases (AC1-AC6, with AC2b split out) covering every REQ-005 acceptance criterion. Used docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-003.md as the direct template, updated for a fourth locale. Every script/curl/node/npm command in the spec was actually executed against the real current repo state during authoring (routing.ts already has kk added, messages/kk.json already exists from Step 2): key-set equality (177/177, missing=[], extra=[], empty=[]), verbatim-diff check (diff_keys=[] — the critical REQ-005-specific case, since unlike REQ-003's en.json this locale has zero divergence including Metadata.ogLocale="ru_RU"), npm run build (real terminal output quoted, exit 0, ƒ /[locale] and ƒ Proxy (Middleware) present), curl against a running npm run start server for <html lang> on /kk /ru /uz /en, root redirect, invalid-locale negative check, and exact LocaleSwitcher markup on all four routes (all four <div class="lang">...) strings). AC6 (missing-translation-key check) was proxied by an automated fetch of /kk (85689 bytes), grep for MISSING_MESSAGE (0 hits), section id landmarks (10 present), and a Node check confirming Hero.title/Metadata.title/Footer text render verbatim from ru.json with correct Cyrillic encoding — spec still requires TEST-RUNNER to do the manual 4-viewport/theme browser pass since a grep can't catch a visual regression. No TODOs left in the spec.
